**What problem are you trying to solve?**

**What would the API look like?** (a short code sketch helps)

**Alternatives you considered** (including "use library X alongside reqkit")

reqkit stays small and dependency-free on purpose, so a good request explains why this belongs in a *kit of small functions* rather than in your app.
